title: EPS attach result
text: The purpose of the EPS attach result information element is to specify the result of an attach procedure
The EPS attach result information element is coded as shown in figure 9.9.3.10.1 and table 9.9.3.10.1
The EPS attach result is a type 1 information element
Bit 4 of octet 1 is spare and shall be coded as zero

fields.name: EPS attach result value
fields.description: Bits 3-1: 001 = EPS only, 010 = combined EPS/IMSI attach. All other values are reserved.

notes: EPS attach result value (octet 1): Bits 3 2 1 - 0 0 1 = EPS only, 0 1 0 = combined EPS/IMSI attach
Bit 4 of octet 1 is spare and shall be coded as zero
